title: Find Building Where Alice and Bob Can Meet
summary: Given an array of building heights, determine the leftmost building where Alice and Bob can meet for each query.
statement: Given an array of building heights, determine the leftmost building where Alice and Bob can meet for each query. If they cannot meet, return -1. Alice starts in building ai, Bob in bi, and they can only move to taller buildings.
constraints: From building i a person may move only right to a strictly taller building.
For each pair, return the leftmost building both can reach, or -1.
hints: After ordering starts a<=b, b is immediate only when a=b or height[a]<height[b].
Otherwise find the first index after b whose height exceeds height[a].
Build a range-maximum tree and descend left-first while pruning ranges whose maximum is too small.
The direct cases are necessary and sufficient at b; the pruned left-first search returns the earliest later common destination.
editorial: The direct cases are necessary and sufficient at b; the pruned left-first search returns the earliest later common destination.

tests.explanation: Direct reachability and later first-taller searches produce 2,5,-1,5,2.
Each query is resolved by the later start or the first later height above both starts.
